About Us TechMinds is an HR consultancy with a main focus on Tech &
IT. Your advantage: Through us, your application documents are sent
directly to the decision maker. In addition, you benefit from free
advice on all your career questions. And you get an authentic insight
into the daily work routine of your potential employer at an early
stage. Tasks You develop and improve the distributional forecasting
models of a growing software company in the grocery retail sector,
working across model architecture, calibration and coverage You deepen
existing production models, monitor forecast quality metrics
continuously and act quickly when performance degrades You identify
where current approaches reach their limits and shape what comes next
methodologically You make substantial contributions to the inventory
simulation and ordering policy framework and drive improvements
through to production You shape the technical direction in your focus
area, contribute to methodology decisions and hold a high bar for code
quality, testability and production readiness across the team You take
responsibility for end-to-end pipeline quality, from input data
integrity through forecast output to the performance of live order
recommendations, including regular backtesting and monitoring You ship
production-quality work with well-tested, readable and thoroughly
reviewed code, using agentic AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code,
Cursor) as part of your daily workflow You work closely with
engineering, product, sales and customer operations and translate
operational findings from store level into product improvements
Profile You hold an MSc or PhD in a quantitative field such as
statistics, mathematics, physics, operations research or computer
science You have built systems that make decisions under uncertainty
with real operational consequences, not just research prototypes Your
background is in at least one of probabilistic forecasting, stochastic
inventory simulation or operations research, with solid working
knowledge across the others You are deeply familiar with
distributional and probabilistic forecasting methods (e.g. quantile
regression, LGBM with distributional output, GAMLSS-type models,
conformal prediction) You have a solid grounding in stochastic
inventory theory, newsvendor models, related ordering policies and
service level optimisation You write production-grade Python and SQL
on large, messy, real-world data and have experience with ML model
evaluation and monitoring in production settings You are comfortable
working with GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Run, Vertex AI) and dbt, and you are
familiar with workflow orchestration (Airflow or Cloud Composer), Git,
containerisation and CI/CD You use agentic AI coding tools (Claude
Code, Cursor or similar) with daily fluency You translate complex
mathematical reasoning into decisions that product teams and
non-technical colleagues can act on You ideally bring experience from
supply chain optimisation, demand planning or retail, ideally combined
with startup or scale-up experience You are fluent in English; German
is not required Benefits You receive an attractive compensation
package including equity participation (VSOP) Home-Office
possibilities 30 vacation days You receive individual relocation
support if you are moving to Berlin Kontakt Further details apart from
the job description as well as information about the company are
available during the application process.

About us At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Scandinavian
EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring
learning and belonging to every child. Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19
countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance,
belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be
physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it
bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both
educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.
We’re established enough to have a proven solution and strong
financial foundations, yet still small enough for every new colleague
to have a visible impact on our next stage of growth. The Opportunity

- Account (Sales) Manager (m/w/d) We are already quite established in
Germany. With 1,500+ units already deployed nationwide with almost no
churn across strategic customers, it’s a proven, trusted, and loved
solution - used by teachers who need a reliable way to include absent
students, welcomed by families who feel their child is still
"there,” and embraced by pupils who can see, speak, and belong
again. The references are real, and the impact is repeatable at scale.
Our next chapter is expanding our footprint in Baden-Württemberg - a
strategic, organic expansion that extends what already works. It
represents a massive and vital opportunity for our mission. We’re
bringing the same quality, reliability, and outcomes that defined
success elsewhere, and we’re looking for a sales professional to
play a pivotal role in driving growth across the region. As Account
Manager, you will set your strategic focus, open executive-level doors
across education and public authorities, and orchestrate
multi-stakeholder decisions. Your craft is relationships: You’ll
cultivate a high-trust network across all your stakeholders - engaging
in person to move complex decisions forward. You will lead with rigor,
listen with empathy, and with executive credibility, you’ll turn
early wins into lighthouse references, and lay the operating cadence
that keeps momentum compounding year after year. What You’ll Do
Define and drive your territory strategy: Build and execute the
go-to-market plan for your focus area within the region -
segmentation, territory mapping, prioritizing key accounts, and
setting milestones that turn strategic goals into tangible outcomes.
Build strategic executive relationships: Build trust with education
authorities, municipal leaders, and school executives - map decision
paths, align to policy and budget cycles, and secure multi-level
sponsorship. Win and expand strategic accounts: Lead full-cycle
acquisition and growth; align executive sponsors, budget owners, and
procurement; run multi-stakeholder close plans to signed agreements.
Lead with consultative, framework-led sales: Combine solution selling
with proven methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN, Challenger)
to pressure-test value, control timelines, and move from business case
to signed terms. Collaborate for seamless delivery and growth: Partner
with Customer Success, Marketing, and Product teams to ensure smooth
onboarding and implementation, capture outcomes, and turn success into
expansion and credible references. Create regional momentum: Build a
trusted partner network (associations, advocacy groups, integrators)
to accelerate adoption, and build visible presence by speaking at and
hosting conferences, roundtables, and policy forums to shape the
inclusion agenda. What You Bring New-business track record with
long-tail sales cycles (Germany): Solid B2B experience - creating and
closing multi-stakeholder deals, managing long cycles, and driving
consensus to close. Experience selling to the educational or public
sector will be a strong advantage. Executive relationship builder:
Ability to build credibility and earn trust from C-suite to school
leaders - advancing complex decisions through purposeful face-to-face
engagement and secure executive sponsorship. Strategic GTM & execution
discipline: Ability to build a targeted GTM strategy and turn it into
an operating rhythm - market segmentation, decision-maker mapping,
phased milestones, pipeline hygiene, and accurate forecasting
(HubSpot). Structured, consultative selling: Ability to run structured
discovery and build quantified ROI cases; experience with
methodologies such as MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN or Challenger is
beneficial. Language & location: Native-level German and professional
English; based anywhere within the Baden-Württemberg region. What We
Offer Proven platform: Expand within Baden-Württemberg with national
credibility, strong references, delivery expertise, and clear demand.
Territory ownership & autonomy: Own a key territory with significant
autonomy and decision-making responsibility. Growth & development:
Access to enablement, coaching, industry events, and opportunities to
help shape best practices as we grow in Germany. Tools &
cross-functional support: Work closely with Customer Success,
Marketing, and Product, with access to sales collateral, case studies,
and training. Scandinavian purpose-led culture: High standards,
meaningful work, and the freedom to do your best work. Highly rated
workplace: Engagement scores above benchmark, structured onboarding
with a buddy program, an annual company trip, and a collaborative
culture. Generous vacation: 27 days of annual leave plus public
holidays. Mobile & internet: Reimbursement for mobile phone and
internet subscriptions. JobAuto: Car leasing through salary sacrifice.
Annual company get-together: A yearly multi-day event focused on
connection, socializing, and memorable shared experiences.

Job Description: Techtronic Industries (TTI) is a world leader in
cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools,
outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare and cleaning products.
Our focus is on end-users that range from professionals in the
industrial, construction and infrastructure sectors to DIYers in home
improvement, repair, and maintenance. TTI’s powerful brand portfolio
includes MILWAUKEE®, RYOBI®, AEG® – recognized worldwide for
their deep heritage and innovative product platforms of superior
quality. The company maintains a global manufacturing and product
development footprint, with record world-wide sales of approximately
US$15.2 billion and around 50,000 employees in 2026. Hiring
exceptional people is a top focus at TTI. This drives a
high-performance culture across all levels of our organization and
helps to achieve our vision of being number one in the industries we
serve. Our unique high-speed decision-making process supports our
acute focus on developing superior products and meeting high customer
expectations. We view our winning culture as a competitive advantage
that powers our growth. To strengthen our team in Winnenden (Stuttgart
area) as soon as possible, we are looking for a Sustainability Data
Analyst (f/m/d) Your role: Collaborate with business stakeholders and
leadership teams to gather requirements, develop, and support data
modelling and BI solutions for organizational stakeholders Integrate
different data sources into a cohesive data fabric, ensuring data
consistency, accuracy and reliability Conduct business analysis
activities to understand business user requirements and translate data
and information flows within business processes Analyze
sustainability, quality and regulatory data to identify trends,
patterns and areas for improvement Provide insights and
recommendations based on data analysis to support informed
decision-making in sustainability initiatives Perform data profiling,
validation and cleaning to ensure accuracy, completeness, and quality
of enterprise data Maintain data quality standards and enforce data
governance policies, standards and best practices Maintain clear
documentation for data orchestrations, highlighting their value and
contribution to improved data modeling and governance Your profile:
Bachelor's or similar degree in Data Science, Environmental Science,
Sustainability Management, or a related field, or equivalent
professional experience Proven experience with Power BI, Power
Automate, VBA, C++ programming, Python, and SAP QuickViewer Good
communication skills in German and English, both written and spoken
Knowledge of Qlik Sense and IBM Envizi is considered an advantage
Relevant experience in data analysis, reporting, and data
visualization Your perks: An interesting position with an attractive
company – recognized as a "top employer” by kununu Free parking
spaces directly next to the office and good public transport
connections Fresh fruit, water and hot beverages for free Company
fitness via "EGYM Wellpass” Bicycle leasing via "JobRad” EAP
(mental support for employees) Learning platforms such as
"GoodHabitz” and "Learn TTI” for your professional development
Special employee benefits via "Family & Friends” and additional
corporate benefit Are you interested? Then send your application via
our careers page. Naturally, we will treat your application with the
utmost discretion. We look forward to getting to know you! Techtronic
Industries ELC GmbH Human Resources – Agnese Cesarini ·
Max-Eyth-Straße 10 · 71364 Winnenden
www.ttigroup.com/careers/global-career-opportunities

Purpose of your Job

Are you looking for a career in research & development of biopharmaceuticals or in general in the pharmaceutical industry?
Then join Coriolis Pharma and contribute with state-of-the-art capillary electrophoresis analytics to our formulations and lyophilization processes for biopharmaceutical drugs!
You will join a highly motivated, interdisciplinary team performing contract research and development for customers in the (bio) pharmaceutical industry worldwide.
You will be a vital part of our contract research organization – where you will support & learn from our scientific operations teams – to enable our clients in their journey of developing innovative drugs.

Your Responsibility

As Senior Scientist you are - together with the project team - responsible for the successful development and execution of capillary electrophoresis (CE) analysis for our customers worldwide.  

- Responsible—as subject matter expert—for supporting client project acquisition and execution with expertise to ensure high-quality services.
- Accountable for the electrophoretic characterization of biopharmaceutical molecules (proteins, peptides, nucleic acids) within client projects, including the de novo development of CE methods and the interpretation of data in context with other analytical approaches (such as LC-MS or LC-IEX).
- Maintain cutting-edge scientific knowledge in CE and related areas and drive CE innovation to meet evolving business needs, including new business areas and novel molecular modalities.
- Work cooperatively across Coriolis teams (e.g., business development, finance, technical support team) to ensure seamless collaboration with all operational groups during client project execution.
- Function as project leader for assigned client projects, overseeing project planning, method implementation, development, characterization, data evaluation, and reporting activities.

What you need to succeed

- University degree in analytical chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, (bio)chemistry, or a related field; a PhD related to separation sciences—ideally focused on CE applications / method development and associated areas—is preferred
- Minimum 5 years of industry experience (with PhD in a relevant field) or 9 years (without PhD) with in-depth knowledge of biopharmaceutical characterization by CE (CE-SDS, CZE, cIEF) using UV, PDA, LIF, or FLD detection
- Several years of hands-on experience with CE instruments from different vendors (e.g., Sciex, BioTechne/ProteinSimple, Agilent, etc.)
- Proven experience in developing, transferring, and troubleshooting CE (and associated) analytical methods in an industry setting, including both R&D and GMP environments
- Demonstrated project management skills, including resource management, multitasking, prioritization, and risk management
- Strong lateral leadership capabilities, with leading by example as a natural approach
- Hands-on, proactive mindset with openness to new ideas and tasks; a can-do attitude is essential
- Team-oriented personality with strong motivational and interpersonal skills
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

Your mission

• Installing Linux on a cluster for providing high available services
• Configuration of network components and serial connections

Your profile

• Extensive knowledge of Linux operating system (RedHat preferred) in an HA environment
• Knowledge of MS Windows clients, network equipment and server hardware (MS Server 2019 or later and active directory)
• Structured and organized approach to work with a hands-on attitude
• Working as a true member of the IT team
• Very good English knowledge

Why us?
• Flexitime without core working time
• 30 days holiday
• Good work-life balance through mobile working
• Workation
• Individual support with regular further training programmes
• Working in international teams
• Possibility to use Jobrad, Wellpass, Deutschlandticket, corporate benefits
• Workplace in the four-country region on Lake Constance with attractive leisure opportunities

MISSIONAt STAN, Account Managers are project owners and trusted client partners – not traditional coordinators. They build strong day-to-day client relationships, turn briefs into clear actions and connect strategy, creative and production to move projects forward. They own projects from brief to delivery, keeping teams, timings and budgets on track while contributing to the quality, ambition and exceptional creative work that defines STAN.
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
• Actively integrate AI-powered tools into day-to-day project workflows to improve efficiency, planning, documentation, communication and delivery. Identify opportunities for AI-supported automation and resource planning, streamlining processes and reducing repetitive manual tasks
• Lead integrated projects and campaigns from briefing through strategy and creative development to production and final delivery
• Understand client needs and translate them into clear briefs, scopes, priorities and next steps for internal teams
• Connect and coordinate interdisciplinary teams across strategy, creative, content, social and production
• Take ownership of project scopes, timings, resources and budgets, ensuring projects are delivered successfully and profitably
• Keep a close eye on project profitability, cost estimates, forecasting and external costs
• Anticipate challenges early and proactively develop solutions together with the Account Director and project team
• Prepare and lead client meetings, project presentations, status updates and budget conversations
• Manage campaign and content productions as well as external partners, freelancers and suppliers
• Ensure a high standard of work throughout the entire project – from briefing to final delivery
• Understand how ideas translate across different channels and touchpoints – from campaigns and content to social, digital and emerging formats
• Stay curious about culture, technology, platforms and changing audience behaviour and bring relevant developments into your projects
• Build strong day-to-day relationships with our clients and act as a reliable and confident point of contact throughout projects
• Contribute to continuously improving the way we work – within project teams, across disciplines and together with our clients

YOUR PROFILE
• 3-4+ years of experience in account management, project management or a comparable client-facing role within a creative, brand, digital or integrated agency
• Strong AI literacy and practical experience using AI-powered tools in day-to-day project management, including AI-supported automation, resource planning and workflow optimisation. A proactive mindset and curiosity to continuously explore emerging AI technologies and translate them into practical improvements. AI proficiency is an essential part of how we work at STAN, not an optional additional skill
• Proven experience independently managing client relationships and complex projects
• A strong understanding of contemporary brand communication across campaigns, content, social and digital
• Experience working closely with strategy, creative and production teams and bringing different disciplines together
• Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, stakeholders and priorities at the same time
• Solid commercial understanding, including scoping, cost estimation, budget management, forecasting and project profitability
• Experience in planning and delivering campaigns, content and productions
• Confidence in client communication, presentations and budget conversations
• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and the confidence to take ownership and make decisions
• The ability to bring structure to complex projects without slowing down the creative process
• Experience with fashion, beauty, lifestyle or culturally relevant brands is a plus, but not a requirement
• Excellent communication skills and fluency in German and English

About us STAN is a global creative group working where culture moves.
Across our global network, we bring together talented strategists, creators and technologists who believe that culture is built – not bought .

We believe in the work, the craft, and the people we build with.

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) for the Electrical Auxiliary Systems of our Gas Turbines, Steam Turbines, and Generators, you will be supporting Siemens Energies growing Power Plant Project Business and be a part of our global supply chain Team. You are responsible to secure the best performing supply base in quality, reliability, and safety and work closely with Procurement and Engineering functions in a multicultural environment. The suppliers in your scope will be the Electrical Auxiliary Systems suppliers in Europe supplying for projects worldwide. Typical equipment in scope includes Power Control Center (Electrical/Instrumentation/Controls), Switchboards, Panel Boards, Switchgears, Low Voltage Transformers, Starting Frequency Converter, Static Excitation System, Batteries & Charging Systems, E-houses, Cables, and Bus Ducting.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Supplier Monitoring: Perform supplier oversight and final product inspection during Factory Acceptance Test for regular project execution to ensure compliance with specification of our electrical components. Create inspection reports and follow up with punch list
* Nonconformance Management: Identify and initiate containment on any identified supplier non-conformances. Follow-up with corrective and preventive action as necessary
* Supplier Performance: Track Supplier performance, create reports and take adequate measures to implement supplier quality improvement- or risk mitigation measures
* Process Excellence: Utilize the various Supplier Quality tools landscape e.g. to create process transparency or generate performance reports. Your ideas on how to evolve our corporate digitalization landscape, for example by leveraging agentic AI, are highly welcome

What You Bring

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical, industrial engineering, or a similar discipline. Equivalent combinations of education, training, and experience will be considered
* Multiyear professional experience in supplier quality management, quality management, engineering or another related technical role in the Power Generation Industry or comparable industry related to the equipment scope mentioned above
* Knowledge and experience in auditing, with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 Lead Auditor certification preferred
* Familiarity with quality methods such as 5 Why, FMEA, 8D, and RCA
* Understanding of specific component technologies and standards (or equivalents) like NEC, NFPA, IEEE, and UL is an advantage
* Willingness to travel approximately 40% of the time and strong communication skills in English

About the Team

Our Gas Services team offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a shareholder of Siemens Energy
* We offer a wide range of options for balancing family and career, such as flexible working time models, childcare facilities at many locations, the option of trial part-time work or a sabbatical
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Air Power Engineering - Mission Systems , Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Electronic Warfare Developer (d/m/f)

The successful applicant will join the Combat Algorithm Development and Prototyping team within the Mission System Center of Competence, dedicated for bridging the gap between theoretical mathematical models and deployable, real-world combat systems.

The team designs, codes, and validates high-performance algorithms that drive autonomous decision-making, target acquisition, and mission optimization. By rapidly prototyping these solutions, it is ensured that the relevant technologies are robust, scalable, and ready for integration into next-generation defence platforms.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

In this position you will be in charge to:

- Support the development of EMO Management software components for Spectrum Management and the EMO Decision Advisor
- Work on the "classical (non-AI)" part of the EMO (Electro-Magnetic Operations) Decision Advisor
- Integrate software components up to TRL5 and (possibly) support the handover to the product development team
- Perform integration and testing of software components in combination with the simulation tool JADES

Desired skills and qualifications

- Master´s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
- Analytical Thinking: Ability to simplify complex, abstract concepts into practical software solutions.
- Collaboration & Communication: Effective team player comfortable working in cross-functional, multi-disciplinary engineering environments.
- Precision & Quality: Strong attention to detail regarding code robustness, integration testing, and documentation standards.
- English: Business fluent (written and spoken)

Required:

- Working with VS-NfD data
- Capability to translate (abstract) concepts into executable source code
- Programming skills in C
- Software development experience using an IDE (currently Eclipse is used)
- Knowledge of and hands-on experience with Doxygen, Git, Wireshark and Matlab
- Knowledge of Linux on command line level
- Software documentation

Desired:

- Knowledge about python and JADES
- Knowledge about communication protocols (NDAS, CESMO, Link 16)
- Knowledge about avionics software development

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Job description

In order to support Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Flight Operations Engineer (d/f/m)

A vacancy for a Technical Publication Flight Operations Engineer (d/f/m) (for Non-approved operational manuals) has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space in Manching.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Develop and maintain non-approved operational documentation (e.g., FCOM, MMEL, QRH) for flight crews and operators of unmanned systems.
- Define normal, abnormal, and emergency procedures in close coordination with key stakeholders.
- Author structured, end-user-centric flight operations documentation and establish project-specific authoring rules.
- Contribute to develop the project specific authoring rules and guidelines for the specific manuals.
- Provide source data for Electronic Checklists (ECL) to ensure seamless display in Ground Stations.
- Assess and implement configuration criteria to ensure accurate content delivery to operators.
- Ensure consistency and continuity with the approved operational manuals and ECL.
- Participate in the continuous improvement of tools or processes for flight operations manuals.
- Support the Technical Publications community in applying defined processes and ensuring consistency across manuals.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Experience in flight operations is highly beneficial/recommended
- University degree in Engineering (Aerospace Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Technical Documentation, or equivalent qualification)
- Professional experience in an engineering or technical documentation role
- Sound understanding of aircraft/complex systems with the ability to quickly acquire technical system knowledge
- Proficiency in XML authoring tools (e.g., FODM, PTC Arbortext, Oxygen, XMLSpy) and familiarity with documentation standards (e.g., S1000D, ATA Spec 2300)
- Strong communication skills with the ability to formulate complex technical content clearly ("crew/operator language")
- Proactive mindset, strong organizational capabilities, autonomous working style, and team-oriented collaboration skills
- Fluent communication skills in English; proficiency in Spanish or French is an advantage

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Job description

In order to support Mass Properties department, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working Student (d/f/m) in the area of Mass Properties

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of a Working Student (d/f/m) in the area of Mass Properties?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Mass Properties department as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Manching
- Start: January 2027
- Duration: 12 months

Definition working student

Working students (d/f/m) are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our mission

Mass Properties Manching is responsible for defining, calculating, and controlling the mass data set throughout the entire life‑cycle of an aircraft. This data set includes mass, centre of gravity and moment of inertia at component, system and aircraft levels. It is required, for example, for the preliminary design of future projects, structural design, system development, support of flight‑test campaigns, and in‑service support. Consequently, the department maintains interfaces with a variety of disciplines, both within and outside the Flight Physics domain. To keep the growing mass properties data set organised and to trace every change throughout the development of our new projects, we are building a Python‑driven, SQLite‑backed database application. In parallel, we are exploring how AI‑based automation can further increase the efficiency and accuracy of our analyses.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Python Software Development: Develop, maintain, and improve Python-based applications and reusable software components for managing aircraft mass data.
- Database Management: Support the design and implementation of database structures, queries, and data models using relational databases.
- Workflow Automation: Identify and automate repetitive engineering workflows and data-processing tasks to increase efficiency.
- Data Integration & Processing: Develop tools for importing, validating, transforming, and integrating data from various engineering sources and tools.
- AI Research & Prototyping: Investigate and evaluate the application of AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) by developing prototypes for engineering workflows.
- Software Quality Assurance: Ensure software reliability by developing automated/manual test cases, documenting bugs, and improving code maintainability.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in Computer Science, Data Science, Informatics, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
- Good programming skills in Python and a strong interest in software development.
- Basic knowledge or a strong interest in the following areas: SQL and relational databases (e.g., SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL), Software architecture and Object-Oriented Programming, Data processing, automation, and software testing.
- Interest in learning and working with technologies such as: PyQt for GUI development, Git for version control, Jira and Confluence for project management, AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
- Ability to translate complex engineering problems into structured software solutions through a self-organized and analytical way of working.
- Advanced English; German is a plus.

jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Shape the future of drug discovery through scientific innovation and collaboration.
Join a highly innovative environment where cutting-edge science, advanced technologies, and multidisciplinary teamwork come together to address some of the most challenging questions in pharmaceutical research. This is a unique opportunity to contribute your expertise, influence scientific strategies, foster collaboration across global teams, and help drive breakthroughs that have the potential to improve patients' lives worldwide.
Ready to make a lasting impact? Apply now and be part of our journey to transform the future of healthcare.
Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you will identify, develop, validate, and advance state-of-the-art computational methods in molecular AI/ML, cheminformatics, and structure-based drug design.
- You will drive the application of these innovative computational approaches to support the discovery and optimization of novel lead compounds.
- Furthermore, you will partner closely with medicinal chemists, computational scientists, and multidisciplinary project teams to understand scientific needs and priorities.
- You will communicate model outputs and limitations effectively and translate computational insights into actionable recommendations.
- Moreover, you will collaborate with software engineers, data scientists, and other partners to develop and deploy scalable computational workflows for molecular design, synthesis planning, and decision support, integrating them into our digital ecosystem.
- Finally, you will mentor postdoctoral researchers and scientists, and establish, lead, and supervise internal and external scientific collaborations.

Requirements

- PhD in Computer Science, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline
- Several years of experience applying computational approaches to drug discovery within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related life sciences industry
- Strong expertise in machine learning, artificial intelligence, and data science methodologies to chemical data
- Demonstrated knowledge in one or more of the following areas: molecular property prediction, foundation models for molecular data, generative molecular design, reaction prediction, structure-based modeling, or agentic AI for scientific discovery
- Proven proficiency in Python-based scientific computing, machine learning frameworks, and cheminformatics tools such as RDKit
- Experience with collaborative software engineering best practices, including version control, testing, and CI/CD workflows
- Creative, collaborative, and proactive mindset, with excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills and a demonstrated ability to influence and work effectively across multidisciplinary teams

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
WHY BOEHRINGER INGELHEIM?
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.
Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

Our Junior Research Group "Epithelium Microbiome Interactions" (headed by Dr. Jens Puschhof) is seeking, starting at the earliest date possible, a Administrative Lab Technician.

In the EMIL group, we study how bacteria contribute to cancer development, metastasis, and treatment response. Our team includes cancer researchers, tissue engineers, microbiologists, and bioinformaticians working together to help patients by deciphering the functional impacts of bacteria in human tumors.
Using tissue samples from patients, we isolate bacterial strains and create organoids. These models can be combined with additional features of the human gut on USB stick-sized devices, “organ chips”, for detailed studies. We transplant organoid-bacteria mixtures into mouse models to study their migration and interaction in a whole-body context.
In our unique biobank at DKFZ, we characterize both tumor organoids and tumor-resident bacterial strains through whole genome sequencing, fluorescence microscopy, and other cutting-edge methods. Based on the diverse data obtained, we develop hypotheses about how specific bacterial species might influence tumors. With our broad portfolio of patient-derived models, our main focus lies on testing these relationships. Through close collaborations with clinical partners, we work towards the rapid translation of our findings into new microbiome-based strategies for the detection, prevention, and treatment of cancer.

Your Tasks

- Organization and coordination of day-to-day laboratory operations, including inventory management, procurement, equipment maintenance, shipping, and logistics
- Coordination of occupational safety, biosafety, and laboratory safety procedures, including support with regulatory documentation and internal inspections
- Organization and quality control of shared consumables, reagents, and laboratory spaces
- Experimental and administrative management of the organoid biobank and bacterial strain collection
- Performance and coordination of key laboratory assays, particularly genotyping and mycoplasma testing
- Onboarding, practical instruction, and supervision of students and new group members
- Communication and coordination with suppliers, service providers, internal DKFZ units, and external collaboration partners

Your Profile

- Completed vocational training as a laboratory technician or an equivalent qualification
- Very good practical knowledge of biological and/or molecular biology laboratory work and laboratory organization
- Ideally, experience with inventory management, procurement, equipment coordination, and laboratory documentation
- Knowledge of occupational safety, biosafety, and relevant documentation requirements is an advantage
- Independent, structured, and reliable working style with strong organizational skills
- Very good communication and coordination skills when working with scientists, students, internal service units, and external partners

- Very good written and spoken English and German

KINDERPSYCHOLOGE (M/W/D)

CHILD PSYCHOLOGIST / KINDERPSYCHOLOGE (M/W/D) – ENGLISH-SPEAKING POSITION

Kennziffer: Child Psychologist

ABOUT US:

Joy Center Family Institute is a multidisciplinary clinic specializing in child development, emotional well-being, and family support. Located in Böblingen (Stuttgart), we serve a diverse international community, including civilians families connected to the U.S. military.

We are known for our holistic, relationship-based, and play-centered therapy approach, following developmental models like DIR/FLOORTIME. Our mission is to empower children and families while nurturing growth, connection, and emotional well-being.

WE ARE CONTINUOUSLY EXPANDING OUR TEAM AND ARE CURRENTLY HIRING:

• Clinical Child Psychologists.
• Licensed Psychotherapists (able to work in Germany).
• Occupational Therapists.
• Speech and Language Therapists.

CURRENT VACANCY: Clinical Child Psychologist / Psychotherapist.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• THERAPEUTIC WORK: Provide individual and family-based psychological therapy for children aged 2-15. Focus areas often include developmental challenges, emotional regulation, behavioral concerns, social skills, and attachment-based issues.
• DEVELOPMENTAL FOCUS: Apply relationship-based, play-based models such as DIR/Floortime to foster emotional and developmental growth.
• ASSESSMENTS: Conduct psychological assessments and developmental screenings as needed.
• FAMILY SUPPORT: Engage, coach, and collaborate with parents and caregivers as part of each child's therapeutic journey.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY TEAM COLLABORATION: Participate in regular weekly supervision and team case discussions with other psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech/language therapists.
• DOCUMENTATION: Maintain accurate, timely clinical notes and assessment reports.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

• Degree in Psychology (Master's or Doctorate level).
• Licensed as a CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGIST or PSYCHOLOGICAL PSYCHOTHERAPIST with eligibility to practice in Germany (e.g., approbation or equivalent).
• Experience working with young children and families, ideally with ages 2 to 15.
• Familiarity with developmental models such as DIR/Floortime, play therapy, or other child-centered approaches (or willingness to learn).
• English fluency (our client base is international).
• Strong interpersonal skills, flexibility, and genuine passion for child development and family-centered work.

WHAT WE OFFER:

• FULL-TIME POSITION: 40 hours per week, with a balance between clinical work (28 hours) and time for documentation, supervision, and team meetings (12 hours).
• ONGOING SUPERVISION: Weekly individual and group supervision sessions plus staff meetings for professional growth and peer support.

Position Overview

The Sales Manager will be responsible for developing new business, managing existing customer relationships, and supporting the continued growth of Kartago GmbH.
